faq.q: When will I receive my travel documents?
faq.a: The voucher and tickets are sent by email as soon as payment is received, and no later than seven days before departure for early bookings.

faq.q: Can I change travellers' names after booking?
faq.a: Yes, for most package holidays, up to 21 days before departure. For flight-only tickets, it depends on the airline's fare conditions.

faq.q: How does the four-instalment payment work?
faq.a: A quarter of the amount is charged at booking, then three fee-free monthly instalments. The option appears at checkout for bookings over €200.
Illness, accident, redundancy and a set of reasons listed in the terms. It can only be taken out at the time of booking.

faq.q: My flight is cancelled, what should I do?
faq.a: Contact assistance at the number shown on your voucher, available 24/7. An advisor will look for a rebooking solution with the airline.
